data.name: Bikash
data.gender_notes: Bikash is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Bikash is a Sanskrit word derived from the root 'bikas' which means to cause to grow or develop. In Hindu mythology, Bikash is the name of a sage or a wise man. The name Bikash symbolizes knowledge, wisdom, and enlightenment. The name Bikash carries the meaning “Knowledge, Wisdom” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Bikash usually hope their child will grow to embody knowledge, wisdom and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Bikash is a spiritual name that signifies the growth and development of the mind and intellect. It is a name that is deeply connected to the Hindu god Vishnu, who is believed to be the source of all knowledge and wisdom. The name is also believed to bring blessings of prosperity and success in all areas of life.
data.etymology: Bikash belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Knowledge, Wisdom.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bikash total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
